english: What supply chain management means for AZM and how to manage AZM supplies.
Supply chain — AZM cartons are unloaded and stacked on pallets for distribution.
Supply chain management in AZM is the coordination and oversight of AZM procurement, distribution and use. It covers the whole campaign.
Fewer stock-outs and less overstocking that may lead to wastage.
Support for training and enhanced accountability.
